general.duplicated: Copy created – please check the technical name and activate it.
general.noResultsSubline: There is no entry for “{term}”. Change the search term or reset the filter.
general.emptyFilterSubline: Choose “All” above to see everything again.
general.helpPosition: Smaller numbers come first, e.g. 1 = first material in the configurator.
general.helpSupplierId: ID of the supplier in LieferLotse (32 characters), e.g. for Comdatek. Leave empty without LieferLotse.
general.errorDuplicateTechnicalName: This technical name is already in use – please choose another one.

overview.title: Configurator & calculation
overview.subline: Set up how films, boards and other articles are calculated: calculations with their own formula, materials with prices per m² and options with surcharges.

flow.title: How everything fits together
flow.text: Materials have prices per m². A calculation groups materials and calculates them with options (e.g. laminate, cutting) and tiers. A product profile makes a Shopware product configurable and selects from the calculations – e.g. shower panel with three materials only. In the shop the server always calculates.

profile.title: Product profiles
profile.description: Which Shopware products are configurable: materials from calculations, option rules, limits and surcharges.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: All areas of Mensura at a glance.

calculation.title: Calculations
calculation.description: Calculation templates per article type: format limits, base price per piece, minimum price, price tiers and formula.

material.title: Materials
material.description: Boards and films with price per m², tiers, raw formats and properties.

option.title: Options
option.description: Option groups such as colours, cutting or finishing with values and surcharges (€/m², €/pc, %, flat).

optionSet.title: Option sets
optionSet.description: Configuration steps: which option groups appear after choosing a material or value.

list.emptySubline: Add the first group, e.g. “Colours” with the values 4/0 and 4/4.
list.confirmDelete: Really delete option group “{name}” with all values? Value prices in calculations and rules in product profiles are deleted as well.
list.deleteRestricted: Cannot delete – the group is still in use.

info.title: What is an option group?
info.text: An option group is a choice in the configurator, e.g. “Colours” with the values 4/0 and 4/4. Groups and values are a shared library: “Matt laminate” is the same value for aluminium composite and acrylic. Prices are maintained per calculation. Delivery times and fixed formats (e.g. A1 = 594 × 841 mm) are separate group types.

detail.helpName: How the choice is called in the configurator, e.g. “Colours”.
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key without spaces, e.g. “farbigkeit”. Stored in the configuration of every order – do not change later. Leave empty to derive it from the name on save.
detail.helpType: Standard for normal options, “Delivery time” for values with working days (e.g. standard 5 days, express 3 days), “Fixed format” for formats with dimensions (e.g. A1).
detail.helpDisplayType: How the customer chooses, e.g. select list for colours, tiles with image for finishings.
detail.helpScope: “per item”: each order item has its own choice. “per supplier”: one choice for all items of the same supplier, e.g. delivery time.
detail.helpPosition: Order when no set order applies, e.g. 10 = near the top.
detail.helpHelpText: One sentence with an example for the customer, e.g. “4/0 means: full colour front, blank back.”
detail.helpDescription: Note for the team, e.g. “Only offer for boards up to 5 mm”.
detail.helpRequired: The customer must choose a value; without a choice the calculation's default applies, e.g. “4/0”.
detail.helpShowPriceHint: Off = no surcharges such as “+ €9.00/m²” on the values of this group in the shop; the customer only sees the total price.
detail.introValues: Maintain name, image, badges, follow-up set and exclusions of a value here. Prices per value are in the calculation.
detail.emptyValuesSubline: A group needs at least one value, e.g. “4/0 printed one side”.

value.helpName: How the customer sees the value, e.g. “4/4 printed both sides”.
value.helpTechnicalName: Unique within the group, e.g. “4-4”. Stored in every order – do not change later.
value.helpCode: Short code for the article number, e.g. “44” → ALU3-1000x500-44.
value.helpDescription: Explanation for tile and info text, e.g. “Anti-graffiti can be cleaned of paint.”
value.helpBadges: Short features on the tile, e.g. “UV-resistant”. Confirm each with Enter.
value.helpDeliveryDays: Production and shipping in working days from the order cut-off, e.g. 5 for standard, 3 for express.
value.helpMaxQuantity: Above this the delivery time cannot be chosen, e.g. express only up to 50 pieces. Empty = no limit.
value.helpMaxArea: Not available above, e.g. express only up to 20 m². Empty = no limit.
value.helpMaterials: Empty = for all materials; otherwise only for the selected ones, e.g. express only for aluminium composite.
value.helpFormat: Dimensions of the format for the area calculation, e.g. A1 = 594 × 841 mm.
value.helpAdd: Added to the final format, e.g. hem 40 mm. The larger format is calculated.
value.helpFactor: Open format, e.g. vertical fold: width × 2. Default 1.
value.helpOptionSet: After choosing this value these groups appear in addition, e.g. “Lamination on aluminium” → “Aluminium finishing”.
value.helpExclusions: Values of other groups that do not work with this value, e.g. anti-graffiti not with “0/0 unprinted”.

warnings.noValues: The group has no values yet – there is nothing to choose in the configurator.
warnings.noDays: At least one delivery value has no working days – no delivery date can be shown for it.
warnings.noFormat: At least one fixed format has no dimensions – the area cannot be calculated.

list.emptySubline: Add a set, e.g. “Board finishing aluminium composite” with colours, finishing, drilling and cutting.
list.confirmDelete: Really delete option set “{name}”? Calculations, materials and values lose their reference to it.

info.title: What is an option set?
info.text: An option set is a configuration step: a list of option groups in order. Which groups the customer sees follows from the calculation's start set → the material's follow-up set → follow-up sets of the chosen values. Example: aluminium composite → “Board finishing aluminium composite” (colours, finishing, drilling, cutting).

detail.helpName: Name for the administration, e.g. “Board finishing aluminium composite”.
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key, e.g. “plattenveredelung-alu”. Used in the configurator data. Leave empty to derive it from the name on save.
detail.helpDescription: Note for the team, e.g. “Applies to all aluminium composite thicknesses”.
detail.introGroups: Groups appear in the configurator in this order. Required can differ per set, e.g. finishing optional here.
detail.emptyGroups: No group in the set yet.
detail.helpAddGroup: Standard groups only; delivery time and fixed format appear automatically.
detail.introUsage: Start set of a calculation, follow-up set of a material or of an option value.

warnings.noGroups: The set does not contain any group yet.

list.emptySubline: Add the first calculation, e.g. “Aluminium composite” – a template makes it quicker.
list.confirmDelete: Really delete calculation “{name}”? Option prices, price tables and customer group surcharges are deleted as well.
list.deleteRestricted: Cannot delete: the calculation is still used in a product profile. Remove it there first or deactivate the calculation.

info.title: What is a calculation?
info.text: A calculation is the pricing template for an article type, e.g. “Aluminium composite”: format limits, base price per piece, minimum price, tiers, option prices and the sale rule. Materials are assigned to it; products choose from it via their product profile. Use the test calculator to check every change right away with purchase, sale and margin.

templates.title: Start with a template
templates.intro: The template prefills format, calculation method and tiers. You enter the prices afterwards.

board.title: Board like aluminium composite
board.text: €/m² + €0.50/pc, minimum price €12.50, format up to 1,500 × 3,000 mm.

banner.title: Banner with area tiers
banner.text: €/m² with discount from 10/25/50 m² total area, minimum price €7.00.

label.title: Label / sticker
label.text: Sorts share the quantity, area tiers, a cheaper larger quantity is applied.

flyer.title: Flyer with price table
flyer.text: Price per run from a table, fixed formats (A6–A4).

detail.helpName: Name of the template, e.g. “Aluminium composite”. Shown in the configurator when switching material (“Finishing not available for acrylic”).
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key, e.g. “aluverbund”. Stored in the order snapshot – do not change later. Leave empty to derive it from the name on save.
detail.helpUnit: What the material price refers to, e.g. area for boards (€/m²), piece for flyers.
detail.helpMotifMode: Boards: 2 motifs × 5 pieces = 10 pieces. Labels: 1,000 pieces in total split across 5 sorts.
detail.helpTierScope: “across all motifs”: 2 × 500 flyers count as 1,000. “per motif”: each motif on its own.
detail.helpBestPrice: If a larger quantity costs less (tier jump): show the hint “from 400 pieces only €11.45” or charge the lower price right away.
detail.helpStartSet: Option groups that appear before the material set, e.g. “Basics” with colours. Empty = material sets only.
detail.helpQuantitySteps: Rows of the quantity × delivery matrix in the guided layout, e.g. 1, 2, 5, 10, 25. Confirm each number with Enter.
detail.helpDescription: Note for the team, e.g. “Prices according to Comdatek sale 2026”.
detail.helpActive: Inactive calculations do not calculate; their materials do not appear in the shop.
detail.helpFormatMode: Free = customer enters width × height. Fixed formats = choice such as A1 (option group of type fixed format).
detail.helpLimits: Limits of the final format, e.g. 100–1,500 × 100–3,000 mm for aluminium composite. Materials and product profiles can be narrower.
detail.helpMaxMotifs: Maximum number of motifs or sorts per item, e.g. 20. Empty = no limit.
detail.helpMaxQuantity: Maximum quantity per item, e.g. 500 pieces. Empty = no limit.
detail.helpRotation: Rotated if needed, e.g. 1,600 × 1,000 mm fits as 1,000 × 1,600 mm.
detail.introArea: Area of the item = length × width × pieces. Minimum area and step size apply to this area; prices per m² use the billed area.
detail.helpMinArea: Smaller areas are charged as this area, e.g. 1 m²: 5 × 0.1 m² cost the same as 1 m². Materials can have their own value.
detail.helpAreaRounding: Round up in steps, e.g. 0.1: 1.23 m² → 1.30 m². Empty = exact.
detail.helpAreaScope: Per item (default, e.g. film) or per piece (each piece at least that size).
detail.introRule: The sale rule suggests a sale price from the purchase price (margin calculator). The corridor colours the margin: green on target, yellow below, red if sale ≤ purchase.
detail.helpSaleRule: Target margin 25 % → purchase €26.00 becomes €34.67; markup 25 % → €32.50; factor 1.3 → €33.80; free = no suggestion.
detail.helpSaleRuleValue: Percentage or factor of the sale rule, e.g. 25.
detail.helpCorridor: Target margin corridor, e.g. 20–30 % for Comdatek.
detail.helpPriceRounding: Round the total to these steps, e.g. 0.05. Empty = to the cent.
detail.introBasePrices: Base prices apply to every item of this calculation, e.g. €0.50 per piece for aluminium composite.
detail.helpMinimum: An item never costs less, e.g. €12.50. Materials and product profiles can have their own minimum price.
detail.helpSetup: One-off setup costs per item, e.g. €15.00 for contour-cut programming.
detail.introTiers: Calculation tiers: “price replaces” replaces the material price per m² (if the material has no tiers of its own), “discount %” discounts the subtotal.
detail.introMaterials: These materials are calculated with this calculation. A material can be in several calculations.
detail.helpMaterials: e.g. aluminium composite 3 mm, 4 mm, 6 mm.

options.infoText: Switch on the values offered in this calculation and maintain their price as price components (purchase and sale). With “Deviation per material” a material gets a different price or is the only one with the value (e.g. 4/4 only for aluminium composite). The default value is preselected.
options.helpPreselect: On: the default value is selected on opening, the price appears at once. Off: the customer has to choose, e.g. for banner finishing – no price and no cart until then. Can be overridden in the product profile.
options.allMaterialsUsed: There already is a deviation for every material.

assignment.title: Price for “{value}”
assignment.helpMaterial: “All materials” or only one material, e.g. contour cut more expensive for acrylic.
assignment.helpPosition: Order of the values in this calculation, e.g. 1 = first.
assignment.helpActive: Off = the value is temporarily not available in this calculation.
assignment.helpDefault: Preselected when the customer chooses nothing, e.g. “4/0”.
assignment.noSurcharge: Without price components the value costs nothing extra.
assignment.introTiers: Optional: “price replaces” replaces the first price component from a threshold, “discount %” applies to all components of the value.
assignment.helpRequires: Only available if this value is chosen, e.g. contour cut only with “Matt laminate”.
assignment.helpExcludes: Not together with these values, e.g. anti-graffiti not with “0/0 unprinted”.

customerGroups.card: Customer group surcharges of this calculation
customerGroups.intro: The base sale price applies to resellers. Other customer groups pay a surcharge, e.g. business +12.5 %. An entry here overrides the general surcharge of the customer group.
customerGroups.helpGroup: Shopware customer group paying the surcharge, e.g. “Business”. Resellers need no entry.
customerGroups.helpSurcharge: Percent on the sale price, e.g. 12.5 – also on the minimum price.

tables.infoText: If a calculation has price tables, the base price comes from the matching table instead of material price × area. The table whose key values are all chosen matches (the most specific wins). Intermediate quantities use the row below: 300 flyers = 300 × piece price of row 250.
tables.helpMaterial: Only for this material, e.g. 135 g matt. “All materials” = always applies.
tables.helpType: “per piece” (€0.06) or “for the whole run” (€60.00 for 1,000 pieces).
tables.helpKey: All these values must be chosen, e.g. format “A4” and colours “4/0”.
tables.emptySubline: Without a table the calculation uses material price × area.
tables.importHelp: Per row: run;purchase;sale (semicolon or tab, e.g. copied from Excel). Existing rows are replaced.
tables.importHelpSale: Per row: run;sale (semicolon or tab). Existing rows are replaced.
tables.importErrorLine: This row is not a number: “{line}”

test.intro: Calculates with the shop engine – exactly like the configurator and the cart.
test.helpCustomerGroup: Empty = base sale price (resellers). With a group its surcharge is added.
test.noteSaved: The saved state is calculated – save first.
test.notReady: Cannot be calculated yet: a material is missing (or, in a product profile, a calculation with material). Add it and save.
test.areaLine: Area per piece {piece} m² · total {total} m² · billed {billed} m²
test.saveFirstSubline: The test calculator uses the saved state of the calculation.

warnings.noMaterial: The calculation has no material yet – it cannot calculate anything this way.
warnings.saleBelowPurchase: At least one sale price is not above the purchase price – please check the prices.
warnings.tableNoRows: A price table has no rows yet.

price.helpPurchase: Net purchase price, e.g. €26.00 per m² according to the Comdatek price list. Only visible with the permission “Purchase prices”.
price.helpSale: Net sale price for resellers, e.g. €29.00 per m². Other customer groups get their surcharge on top.

components.hint: Several components are added up, e.g. contour cut = €3.00/m² + €0.50/pc. Discounts with minus, e.g. −€8.00/m² for unprinted.

types.factor: factor on the rate per m²
types.base_area: replaces the material price per m²

tiers.helpBasis: What the tier is measured on, e.g. “Total area”: 5 banners of 3 m² = 15 m² → tier “from 10 m²”.
tiers.warnOrder: Tier jump: thresholds not ascending or a higher tier is more expensive – please check.

supplierCodes.title: Supplier codes
supplierCodes.help: Mensura builds the supplier's article number from these, e.g. Comdatek “29.1” for aluminium composite 3 mm.

info.title: What is a material?
info.text: A material is the carrier that is printed on – e.g. aluminium composite 3 mm or film A. It has a price per m² (purchase and sale), optionally a minimum price, minimum area and tiers. The follow-up set controls which options the customer sees next. The calculation the material is assigned to does the maths.

list.emptySubline: Add the first material, e.g. “Aluminium composite 3 mm” at €29.00 per m².
list.confirmDelete: Really delete material “{name}”? Prices per material in calculations are deleted as well.
list.deleteRestricted: Cannot delete: the material is still used in a product profile. Remove it there first or deactivate the material.

detail.helpName: How the customer sees the material, e.g. “Aluminium composite 3 mm”.
detail.helpTechnicalName: Unique key without spaces, e.g. “alu-3mm”. Used in links and interfaces – avoid changing it later. Leave empty to derive it from the name on save.
detail.helpCode: Short code for the article number, e.g. “ALU3” → ALU3-1000x500.
detail.helpDescription: One or two sentences for the material tile, e.g. “The classic for signs indoors and outdoors.”
detail.helpBadges: Short features on the tile, e.g. “outdoor”, “Bestseller”. Confirm each with Enter.
detail.placeholderBadges: Type a badge and press Enter …
detail.helpActive: Inactive materials do not appear in the configurator but remain in old orders.
detail.helpCalculations: The calculation the material is calculated in, e.g. “Aluminium composite”. Option prices and format limits come from there.
detail.helpOptionSet: Which option groups appear after choosing this material, e.g. “Board finishing aluminium composite” with colours, finishing, drilling and cutting.
detail.introPrice: The suggested sale price follows the sale rule ({rule}). What is in the sale field is always saved.
detail.helpPricePurchase: Purchase price per m², e.g. €26.00 (Comdatek purchase price aluminium composite 3 mm).
detail.helpPriceSale: Sale price per m² for resellers, e.g. €29.00.
detail.helpMinimumPrice: An item never costs less, e.g. €12.50 for aluminium composite, even for a small sign. Empty = minimum price of the calculation.
detail.helpMinArea: Smaller areas are charged as this area, e.g. film A from 1 m²: 0.5 m² costs the same as 1 m². Empty = value of the calculation.
detail.helpAreaRounding: The area is rounded up to these steps, e.g. 0.1: 1.23 m² is charged as 1.30 m². Empty = value of the calculation.
detail.cardComponents: Further price components of the material
detail.introComponents: Added to the base prices of the calculation, e.g. mesh banner €0.20 per piece.
detail.introTiers: A tier replaces the price per m² from a threshold or gives a discount. Purchase and sale can use different bases, e.g. sale by total area, purchase by area per piece.
detail.helpWidthMax: Only needed if the material is narrower than the calculation allows, e.g. roll width 1,370 mm.
detail.helpHeightMax: Only needed if the material is shorter than the calculation allows, e.g. board length 2,000 mm.
detail.helpSheet: Size of the raw board or roll, e.g. 1,500 × 3,050 mm – for later nesting/waste calculation.
detail.helpWeight: For shipping and packaging, e.g. 3.8 kg for aluminium composite 3 mm. Mensura calculates the weight of every item from it.
detail.introSupplier: Optional suggestion who produces the material. The suggestion on the material wins over the calculation.
detail.helpSupplier: Supplier from LieferLotse, e.g. Comdatek. Order distribution decides later.

warnings.noPrice: The material has no sale price per m² yet – the shop cannot show a price for it.
warnings.saleBelowPurchase: The sale price is not above the purchase price – please check the prices.
warnings.noCalculation: The material is not assigned to any calculation and cannot be sold this way.

info.title: Product profile: calculations calculate, products select
info.text: The profile makes a Shopware product configurable. It selects materials from one or more calculations and restricts options, e.g. shower panel: only foam board 5 mm, aluminium composite 3 mm and acrylic 5 mm, laminate fixed to “glass laminate”, drill holes hidden. Prices always come from the calculation of the selected material – the profile can only restrict and add surcharges, never extend. Saved with “Save” at the top right.

profile.emptySubline: With a profile this product becomes configurable in the shop (material, format, options, live price).
profile.readOnly: View only: to edit, your role needs the rights “Mensura · Maintain product profiles” and “Edit products” (Settings → Users & permissions).
profile.newHint: New profile – choose materials and save the product. The profile starts inactive so nothing half-finished appears in the shop.
profile.testAfterSave: The test calculator appears after the product has been saved for the first time.
profile.helpActive: Only switch on when materials and rules are correct. Off = the product shows no configurator, e.g. during setup.
profile.helpType: For overview only: general (e.g. direct board printing, all materials) or special (e.g. shower panels with fixed presets).
profile.helpLayout: Compact (one page, for professionals) or guided (step by step, for new customers). Default = plugin setting, e.g. shower panels guided.

materials.intro: Which materials the customer can choose – also from several calculations. The calculation of the selected material calculates. A single material = fixed, the step “Material” is skipped.
materials.helpCalculation: Calculation the material comes from, e.g. “Aluminium composite”. It provides prices, options and format limits.
materials.helpMaterial: A specific material (e.g. Alu 3 mm) or all materials of the calculation – new materials of the calculation then appear automatically.
materials.helpSurcharge: Surcharge for this material in this product only, e.g. 5 for acrylic in shower panels. Empty = no surcharge.
materials.fixedHint: Only one material: the step “Material” is skipped in the shop.

options.intro: Per option group: inherit (everything from the calculation), restrict (selected values only), fixed (one value, shown as info only) or hidden (invisible, still calculated and sent to the supplier). Deviations per material are possible.
options.empty: Choose materials first – then the option groups of the calculations appear here.
options.helpMode: E.g. drill holes “Hidden” with default “No”, or laminate “Fixed” to “glass laminate”.
options.helpValues: Only these values can be chosen, e.g. cutting only “rectangular”.
options.helpDefault: Preselection in the shop. Required for “Fixed” and “Hidden” – this value is calculated, e.g. “No”.
options.helpMaterialRule: This rule applies only to the selected material and takes precedence, e.g. acrylic: laminate hidden.
options.helpPreselect: Whether the default value is already selected in the shop. “None”: the customer has to choose, no price until then – e.g. banner finishing.

limits.intro: Only narrower than the calculation – wider is not possible. Empty = limits of the calculation or material.
limits.helpFormat: In mm, e.g. shower panel max. 1,500 × 2,550 mm.
limits.helpMinQuantity: Smallest number of pieces per line, e.g. 10 for stickers.
limits.helpMaxQuantity: Largest number of pieces per line, e.g. 5 for shower panels.
limits.helpQuantitySteps: Quantities of the price matrix for this product only, e.g. 1, 2, 5, 10. Empty = as the calculation.

prices.intro: Surcharges of the product on the result of the calculation, before the minimum price, e.g. special product +10 %. Purchase prices are not affected.
prices.helpSurcharge: Percent on the sale price of all materials of this product, e.g. 10.
prices.helpMinimum: A line never costs less, e.g. €49. The higher value of profile and calculation applies.
prices.componentsEmpty: No additional price components, e.g. €2/pc packaging.

shop.card: Preselection and display in the shop
shop.intro: This is how the configurator starts. Empty = default of the calculation. Default values of options are set in the option rules.
shop.helpDefaultMaterial: Material when the page opens, e.g. aluminium composite 3 mm. Empty = the first material.
shop.helpDefaultFormat: Format when opening, e.g. 1,000 × 2,000 mm for shower panels.
shop.helpDefaultQuantity: Quantity when opening, e.g. 1 motif × 1 piece.
shop.helpDisplay: Overrides the plugin setting for this product only, e.g. hide price per m² for shower panels.

copy.title: Take over profile
copy.intro: Takes over materials, option rules, limits, surcharges and display from the profile of another product. The current profile is replaced; it is stored only with “Save”.
copy.helpSource: Product with a Mensura profile, e.g. “Shower panel standard”.
copy.applied: Profile taken over – check and save.
copy.notFound: The selected product has no profile.

remove.confirm: The Mensura profile of this product is deleted immediately (materials and option rules). The product itself is kept.
remove.error: The profile could not be deleted.

warnings.noMaterial: No material selected – the product is not configurable in the shop (tab Mensura, materials).
warnings.materialWithoutCalculation: A material row has no calculation.
warnings.fixedWithoutValue: An option rule “Fixed” or “Hidden” has no default value – the default of the calculation is calculated.
warnings.restrictWithoutValues: An option rule “Restrict” has no allowed values.
warnings.minAboveMax: A minimum value (format or quantity) is greater than the maximum.

list.infoText: All products with a Mensura profile. A profile is edited in the product (tab “Mensura”). New special products are created quickly with “Copy to another product”.
list.copyIntro: Copies the profile of “{name}” (materials, rules, limits) to a product without a profile. The copy starts inactive.
list.copied: Profile copied – check and activate it in the product.
list.helpProduct: Only products without a Mensura profile (main products), e.g. “Shower panel premium”.
list.createIntro: Choose the Shopware product. You then create the profile in the product's “Mensura” tab.
list.emptySubline: A profile makes a Shopware product configurable, e.g. “Aluminium composite boards” with all aluminium composite materials.
list.confirmDelete: Delete the profile of “{name}”? Materials and option rules of the profile are deleted too, the product is kept.

ld_mensura.purchase: Purchase prices, margins and contribution margin
